description: Main FastAPI application for managing personal journal entries, including CRUD operations, verification endpoints, inspection, date filtering, and file upload handling.

methods.name: verify_post_sample()
methods.description: Create a minimal sample entry to verify JSON create path returns 201.

methods.description: Internal helper to verify application/json create path.

methods.description: Simulate multipart PUT update without a file.

methods.name: verify_create_multipart()
methods.description: Internal helper to verify multipart/form-data create path.

methods.name: inspect_request( request: Request, payload: Optional[JournalEntryCreate] = Body(None), title: Optional[str] = Form(None), content: Optional[str] = Form(None), image_remove: Optional[bool] = Form(None), )
methods.description: Return basic info about the request for debugging client payload issues.

methods.name: str _save_upload(file: UploadFile)
methods.description: Save an uploaded image file to the uploads directory with a random name to avoid collisions.

methods.name: None _delete_existing_file(image_url: Optional[str])
methods.description: Delete a file at the specified image URL if it exists.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify service is running.

methods.name: HTTPException _structured_500(message: str, context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Build a structured HTTPException for 500 errors with optional context for debugging.

methods.description: Get list of dates that have journal entries within a specified range.

methods.description: Retrieve a single journal entry by its ID.

methods.description: Update an existing journal entry, supporting JSON and multipart form upload, with image replacement/removal.
